title: Edge operator approval scripts + audit matrix (sketch)
content:
Purpose:
This sketch collates a pragmatic operator-facing approach for: (1) small scripted primitives to run during customer-managed edge operations; (2) a minimal audit-matrix mapping operator actions to evidence artifacts and retention class; and (3) recommended approval webhook flows that integrate with customer-managed network handshakes.

Scope:
- Focused on customer-managed edge / VPC onboarding, emergency rollback, and operator-initiated network changes.
- Intended for Product + SRE + Solutions Engineering; not the final legal retention policy.

Goals:
- Make it straightforward for operators to gather forensics before/after any change.
- Ensure every high-risk action has a repeatable approval + audit artifact set.
- Provide script templates that can be run in constrained customer environments (where we can only push small binaries/scripts).

Non-goals:
- This is not a compliance-ready retention policy (legal should sign off separately).
- Not a full RBAC design for delegated admin.

High level flow (operator change):
1) Operator opens PD-CHG (Jira) and selects change type (network / config / upgrade).
2) System presents checklist + pre-change evidence checklist.
3) Operator runs `edge-collect.sh --pre` which captures KV, route table, BGP state, active sessions.
4) Approval gate: either auto-approve for low-risk or require 1 approver from customer-admin + 1 from Redwood SRE for high-risk.
5) System records approval webhook payload + signer fingerprints into immutable audit store.
6) Operator executes change, runs `edge-collect.sh --post`.
7) System runs lightweight diff, synthesizes forensic summary, attaches to ticket and pushes to long-term evidence store per retention policy.

Audit matrix (summary):
- Action: VPC peering change
  - Pre artifacts: route tables (json), iptables/save, peering auth tokens (hash only), BGP neighbor state snapshot
  - Post artifacts: route table diff, traceroutes to customer test endpoints, syslog snippet (t-5 to t+5 mins)
  - Retention class: high (3 years)
  - Trigger approval: manual (customer + Redwood)

- Action: Edge agent upgrade (minor patch)
  - Pre artifacts: running agent version, health endpoints, KV cache head
  - Post artifacts: agent logs (first 5000 lines), health checks OK/FAIL summary
  - Retention: medium (90 days)
  - Trigger approval: auto if canary pass else manual

- Action: Emergency rollback (customer requested)
  - Pre artifacts: crash dumps, crash timestamps, last-deployed-bundle id
  - Post artifacts: rollback command output, reconciliation status, incident note
  - Retention: high (1 year)
  - Trigger approval: emergency flow (must record JT/incident id + on-call ack)

Minimal audit log schema (recommended fields, newline-separated example):
- event_id: uuid4
- timestamp_utc: 2025-10-02T14:12:07Z
- actor: "redwood:marisa.chen" or "customer:net-admin@example.com"
- action: "vpc-peering.update"
- target: "vpc-12345"
- approval: ["redwood-sre#devon.williams","customer-admin#sara.kim"] (store as signed tokens)
- pre_evidence_sha256: <hex>
- post_evidence_sha256: <hex>
- artifacts: ["s3://evidence/2025-10-02/evt-.../routes.json"]

Operator script primitives (sketches, to be hardened):
- edge-collect.sh (POSIX, minimal deps)
  #!/bin/sh
  mode="$1"
  out_dir="$2"
  mkdir -p "$out_dir"
  date -u > "$out_dir/timestamp.txt"
  ip route show > "$out_dir/routes.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  ip -s neigh > "$out_dir/arp.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  /sbin/ifconfig -a > "$out_dir/ifconfig.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
  # optional: run traceroute to test endpoints if allowed

- evidence-hash.sh
  # simple bundler -> tar.gz -> sha256
  tar czf /tmp/evidence.tar.gz "$1" && sha256sum /tmp/evidence.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}'

Operator UX notes (console + ticket integration):
- Ticket template should embed 1-click pre-collection link that spawns ephemeral signed presigned-URL for the operator to `curl` from the edge host.
- Approvals: webhook contains base64(signed_payload) where signature is Redwood HSM-signed assertion plus customer signature when present.

Automated approval webhook flow (proposal):
- When a change is created, system computes risk score (ruleset) -> if risk <= threshold -> auto-approve and attach signed auto-approval.
- Otherwise, send approval request to approver list via email + Slack + optional customer webhook. Approver responds with signed token or uses our internal approve button (which generates signed token).
- Approval tokens are short-lived and must be replay-protected (nonce + event_id).

Data handling & retention notes (draft):
- Evidence artifacts stored encrypted (customer KMS when in Private) in time-bucketed folders.
- Retention classes: low (30d), medium (90d), high (1-3y). Legal to finalize for each artifact type.

Security considerations:
- Avoid transmitting plaintext secrets: pre-collection should never include private keys; collect only hashes where needed.
- Signed approval tokens must be verifiable offline (so include signer cert chain).
- When customer-managed, prefer customer KMS for long-term storage; Redwood may hold short-lived ephemeral copies for analysis (30d).

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Do we standardize on one evidence archive format (tar+json manifest) or allow per-customer?
- Should approval tokens be JWT or a compact binary signature format?
- Legal: finalize retention windows (particularly for route tables and auth tokens metadata).
- Product: define risk thresholds and who owns ruleset for auto-approve.

Next steps (short):
- Sync with SRE (Devon) to harden edge-collect.sh and run in a staging customer (by 2025-10-16).
- Create RFC for approval token format and threat modeling (owner: Priya).
- Draft evidence manifest schema (owner: Omar) and iterate with Legal.

References and links:
- Confluence draft: PRD-4872
- Jira epic: PD-2218
- Infra PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/428
- Slack thread: #private-deploys (Oct 2 thread)

Notes to self (fragmented):
- need to add example webhook payload and signature verification snippet (python).
- consider a small ember of local sqlite for indexing artifacts on the edge host (if no stable network)

-- end of sketch --
